evidence.name: Screen field: Drop shadow under the button
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Drop shadow under the button" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Drop shadow under the button
sections.description: Optional. Casts a soft shadow beneath the button so it appears lifted off the screen, which helps a primary action stand out. Adjust blur for softness, spread for size, opacity for strength, and offset for direction. A subtle shadow usually looks best; leave it off for a flat, minimal style.
